correctness.rationale: Exact Dirichlet mixture gives a probability of avoiding each subset as a rising-factorial ratio; inclusion-exclusion yields exact survival. Conditioning on a pair’s total Dirichlet mass and its independent Beta split proves strictly increased full coverage under any nontrivial pair balance, since rising factorial is strictly convex for at least two pair draws and for t>=k full outside coverage plus >=2 pair draws has positive probability. The majorization transfer theorem proves the universal order. Gamma ratios and two-missing Bonferroni bound prove the exact minimum-mass tail, conditional last-unseen law and power-moment threshold. 2981 standalone exact/rational/numerical checks independently confirm the finite identities and sample inequalities; the infinite claims are proved analytically.

originality.rationale: The newly scoped statement compares the complete-coverage stopping-time laws of distinct *reinforced* Pólya urns under initial-mass majorization. The closest deterministic-probability theorem (Zoroa et al. 2016, Theorem 6.1) is not an implication: it holds pointwise under majorization of two fixed sampling vectors, whereas Dirichlet draws for different initial-mass shapes are not pointwise ordered. Henze–Holmes 2019 supplies known one-colour tail/moment mechanisms but no multicolour all-coverage initial-mass ordering. Dean 2022 concerns composition functional limits. Scientific literature and mathematical database searches on reinforced coupon coverage, Dirichlet–multinomial majorization, and rare-last-colour laws found no dominating published claim. Historical-priority caveat: an older full-support Dirichlet–multinomial Schur theorem could exist outside these checks.
residual_risks: A classical or later Dirichlet–multinomial full-support Schur-concavity theorem may imply the majorization component without being returned by semantic searches.
The single-colour power-tail exponent and moment boundary are established in Henze–Holmes 2019; novelty is not claimed for those scalar facts.
Only relevant portions, not every page, of the 54-page Dean source were inspected; absence claims are appropriately limited to material read.
No independent specialist priority determination or audit.

value.rationale: The full-coverage time is a canonical reinforced species-discovery stopping variable. Classifying its entire law under initial-mass majorization is substantially stronger than a first moment extremum (the mean may diverge), while the exact polynomial tail and unique least-mass unseen colour describe a robust rare-event regime. The object and global stochastic invariant are naturally motivated by the changing predictive sampling weights, and the result covers all positive real vectors and all time horizons rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
